# EkGuru — Comprehensive AI, RAG & Answer-Engine Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical summary: https://ekguru.shop/llms.txt | Full reference: https://ekguru.shop/llms-full.txt | Website: https://ekguru.shop/

## 1. Entity & Platform Overview (Citation-Ready Summary)

- **Name:** EkGuru (`https://ekguru.shop/`)
- **Tagline:** One Student. One Goal. One Guru.
- **Founder:** Prakash (Alumnus of Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur — MNIT Jaipur), based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.
- **What EkGuru Offers:**
  1. **Zero-Commission 1-to-1 Online Hindi Tutoring:** Independent Hindi tutors in India set their own per-lesson rates ($3–$27 USD per 50-minute lesson). Students message or request lessons directly on each tutor's profile and pay the tutor directly — EkGuru charges **0% commission** and **0 booking markup**.
  2. **0 Free Self-Paced Language Courses (No Account Required):** Complete CEFR A1–C2 Hindi curriculum plus 7 regional Indian languages (`Marathi`, `Gujarati`, `Tamil`, `Telugu`, `Punjabi`, `Urdu`, `Bengali`) and 10 world languages (`Spanish`, `French`, `Chinese`, `Arabic`, `German`, `Italian`, `Japanese`, `Korean`, `Portuguese`, `Russian`).
  3. **13 Free Browser-Based Hindi Practice Tools & 8 Script Converters:** Instant client-side tools for Devanagari letters, numbers, verb conjugation, pronunciation, flashcards, and phonetic name transliteration.
  4. **0 Printable Reference Sheets & 109 Answer-First Q&A Guides:** Direct, source-checked answers to common Hindi learning questions.
- **Privacy & Storage Architecture:** Zero tracking cookies. Lesson progress, spaced-repetition (SRS) cards, and streak journals stay in the learner's own browser (`localStorage`/`IndexedDB`) with optional JSON export.

## 2. Direct Answers to Common Questions (AEO Reference)

### Is EkGuru free to use?
Yes. Every published self-paced language course, grammar guide, interactive browser tool, name-in-script converter, and printable reference sheet on EkGuru is 100% free with no account, login, or subscription.

### How much do live 1-to-1 Hindi lessons cost on EkGuru, and does EkGuru take a commission?
Live 1-to-1 online Hindi lessons with independent tutors range from **$3 to $27 USD per 50-minute lesson**, set by each tutor. EkGuru takes **0% commission** and charges no listing fee to tutors and no platform fee to students; scheduling and payment are arranged directly between student and tutor.

### Can beginners or learners outside India (US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, UAE) learn on EkGuru?
Yes. All self-paced lessons run in any modern browser worldwide, and live 1-to-1 Hindi lessons are conducted online with tutor availability displayed in the learner's local timezone. Many tutors teach complete beginners, heritage/NRI families, children (with parent/guardian involvement), and adult learners.

### Which Indian languages can I learn on EkGuru?
EkGuru publishes 8 free Indian language courses: **Hindi** (`/learn/hindi/`), **Marathi** (`/learn/marathi/`), **Gujarati** (`/learn/gujarati/`), **Tamil** (`/learn/tamil/`), **Telugu** (`/learn/telugu/`), **Punjabi** (`/learn/punjabi/`), **Urdu** (`/learn/urdu/`) — all complete from CEFR A1 to C2 — plus **Bengali** (`/learn/bengali/`, published A1–B2).

## 4. Interactive Hindi Learning Toolbox (13 Browser Tools)

- [Hindi Alphabet Explorer — All 44 Letters](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-alphabet/): Click any Devanagari letter to see its sound, its vowel mark and a real Hindi word that uses it. All 11 vowels and 33 consonants, free, no sign-up.
- [Hindi Days, Months and Telling the Time](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-date-time/): The seven days, twelve months and how to tell the time in Hindi — including डेढ़ and ढाई, the two irregular forms every learner gets caught by.
- [Hindi Flashcards — Free, No Sign-Up, Saves Progress](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-flashcards/): Spaced-repetition Hindi flashcards for phrases, numbers, letters, verbs and dates. Progress saved in your browser. No account, no app.
- [What Level Is My Hindi? — Free Self-Assessment](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-level-test/): Eight honest questions place your Hindi from absolute beginner to advanced, and tell you what to work on next. Free, no sign-up.
- [Hindi Numbers 0 to 100 — Tool and Full Table](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-numbers/): Every Hindi number from 0 to 100 in Devanagari with pronunciation. Type a number, get the Hindi word, or quiz yourself. Free, no sign-up.
- [Hindi Phrasebook — 69 Phrases People Actually Say](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-phrasebook/): Searchable Hindi phrasebook grouped by situation, with Devanagari, pronunciation and the politeness warnings most lists leave out. Free.
- [Hindi Pronunciation Trainer — Minimal Pairs](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-pronunciation/): Twelve pairs of real Hindi words differing in one sound: aspiration, dental vs retroflex, and vowel length. The three things that produce a foreign accent.
- [Free Hindi Quiz — Ten Questions, Different Every Time](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-quiz/): Test your Hindi: phrases, numbers and Devanagari letters, drawn at random. Free, instant, no sign-up and no score sent anywhere.
- [Hindi Text Counter — Free Word, Character & Sentence Tool](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-text-counter/): Count whitespace-separated words, Unicode code points, approximate sentence-ending marks and paragraphs in Hindi or mixed-script text. Free and browser-only.
- [How Long Does It Take to Learn Hindi? — Planner](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-time-planner/): Enter your real weekly hours and see a projection for reading Devanagari, survival Hindi, conversation and fluency. Honest arithmetic, no promises.
- [Type in Hindi — Free Devanagari Typing Tool](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-typing/): Type Hindi in English letters and get Devanagari instantly. Free, no sign-up, works on phone and desktop, with setup instructions for a real Hindi keyboard.
- [Hindi Verbs — The First 20, in Three Tenses](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-verbs/): The twenty Hindi verbs that appear in almost every conversation, in present, past and future, with the gender agreement shown rather than hidden.
- [Hindi Vocabulary by Situation — 69 Words](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/hindi-vocabulary/): Hindi vocabulary grouped by situation: greetings, courtesy, travel, food, family. Search it, filter it, hide a column and test yourself. Free.

## 8. Direct Hindi Q&A Knowledge Base (109 Answer-First Pages)

- [What are the best Hindi movies for learning Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/best-hindi-movies-to-learn-hindi/): Pick films with ordinary conversation rather than poetry or heavy dialogue: 3 Idiots, Queen, Piku.
- [What is the best way to learn Hindi as a complete…](https://ekguru.shop/answers/best-way-to-learn-hindi-as-a-beginner/): Learn Devanagari first — four to eight weeks at twenty minutes a day — then start speaking badly immediately rather than waiting until you feel ready.
- [Can I learn Hindi without learning the Devanagari…](https://ekguru.shop/answers/can-i-learn-hindi-without-learning-the-script/): Yes, and for some goals it is the right choice — if you only want to speak with family or handle a trip.
- [What is the difference between Hindi and Urdu?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/difference-between-hindi-and-urdu/): In everyday speech there is almost none — a Hindi speaker and an Urdu speaker discussing food, family or the weather understand each other completely.
- [What are the body parts in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-body-parts-vocabulary/): सिर sir (head), आँख aankh (eye), नाक naak (nose), कान kaan (ear), मुँह munh (mouth), हाथ haath (hand or arm), पैर pair (foot or leg), पेट pet (stomach).
- [What are the colours in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-colours-list/): लाल laal (red), नीला neela (blue), हरा hara (green), पीला peela (yellow), काला kaala (black), सफ़ेद safed (white), नारंगी naarangi (orange).
- [What are the days of the week in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-days-of-the-week/): सोमवार somvaar (Monday), मंगलवार mangalvaar (Tuesday), बुधवार budhvaar (Wednesday), गुरुवार guruvaar (Thursday), शुक्रवार shukravaar (Friday).
- [What are the family words in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-family-words/): Hindi has a separate word for nearly every relative, because the relationship itself is built into the word.
- [What are the common Hindi greetings besides namaste?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-greetings-namaste-and-others/): नमस्ते (namaste) works everywhere and at any time of day, which is why it is the one everyone learns.
- [What are the months and seasons in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-months-and-seasons/): Everyday Hindi uses the English month names, pronounced with Hindi sounds — जनवरी (janvari), फ़रवरी (farvari), मार्च (maarch).
- [How do you count to 100 in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-numbers-1-to-100/): Hindi numbers are learnt, not built. English gives you twenty-one from
- [What Hindi phrases do I need for travelling in India?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-phrases-for-travelling-in-india/): About fifteen phrases cover most of a trip: a greeting, thank you, how much, where is, too expensive, I don
- [When do you use ka, ki and ke in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-postpositions-ka-ki-ke/): का, की and के all mean "of" or possessive
- [What are the Hindi pronouns and when do you use tu…](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-pronouns-explained/): Hindi has three words for
- [How does the verb 'to be' work in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-verb-hona-to-be/): होना (hona) is the most important verb in Hindi and it is irregular. In the present tense it has five forms: हूँ (hoon) for I, है (hai) for he/she/it and तू.
- [How is Hindi different from Punjabi and Bengali?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-vs-punjabi-vs-bengali/): All three are Indo-Aryan languages descended from Sanskrit, but they are separate languages, not dialects.
- [What is the difference between Hindi and Sanskrit?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-vs-sanskrit-difference/): Sanskrit is the ancient classical language of India; Hindi is a modern language descended from it, roughly as Italian descends from Latin.
- [What is the word order in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/hindi-word-order-explained/): Hindi is subject-object-verb: the verb goes last.
- [How do you ask for directions in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-ask-for-directions-in-hindi/): The one sentence to memorise is …कहाँ है? (…kahaan hai?) — where is…? Point at a map or say the place name in front of it: स्टेशन कहाँ है?
- [How do you order food in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-order-food-in-hindi/): …दीजिए (…deejiye) is the polite
- [How can I practise speaking Hindi alone?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-practice-hindi-speaking-alone/): You can build a great deal alone: shadowing, recording yourself, narrating your day out loud, and talking to a phone
- [How do you say goodbye in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-say-goodbye-in-hindi/): नमस्ते (namaste) is goodbye as well as hello — the same word does both, and it is never wrong. फिर मिलेंगे (phir milenge) means
- [How do you say I am hungry in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-say-i-am-hungry-in-hindi/): Learn मुझे भूख लगी है (“I am hungry”), compare Hindi expressions for thirst and cold, and see a specific restaurant request.
- [How do you say "I am learning Hindi" in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-say-i-am-learning-hindi/): मैं हिंदी सीख रहा हूँ (main hindi seekh raha hoon) if you are male, मैं हिंदी सीख रही हूँ (seekh rahi hoon) if you are female.
- [How do you say please and thank you in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-say-please-and-thank-you-in-hindi/): Thank you is धन्यवाद (dhanyavaad) or the more everyday शुक्रिया (shukriya).
- [How do you tell the time in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-tell-the-time-in-hindi/): Use बजे (baje) for the hour: तीन बजे (teen baje) is three o
- [How do you type in Hindi on a phone or computer?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/how-to-type-hindi-on-phone/): On a phone, add the Hindi keyboard in your settings and use the transliteration mode: type
- [What does "ji" mean in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/answers/what-does-ji-mean-in-hindi/): जी (ji) is a respect marker with no English equivalent. Added after a name or title it makes it polite — नमस्ते जी, पापा जी, गांधी जी.
- [What is the best way to learn Hindi for a complete…](https://ekguru.shop/ask/best-way-to-learn-hindi-for-beginners/): Learn the script in the first two weeks, learn 100 high-frequency words, and start speaking with a person before you feel ready.
- [Can I learn Hindi by myself?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/can-i-learn-hindi-by-myself/): You can reach a good reading and listening level entirely alone — the free material is genuinely excellent.
- [Can I learn Hindi just by watching Bollywood?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/can-i-learn-hindi-from-bollywood-alone/): You can build a very good ear and a large passive vocabulary. You cannot learn to speak, and you will pick up a register that sounds wrong in conversation.
- [Can I learn Hindi in 3 months?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/can-i-learn-hindi-in-3-months/): You can reach useful conversational Hindi in three months — introducing yourself, shopping, directions, small talk.
- [What is the cheapest way to learn Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/cheapest-way-to-learn-hindi/): Free resources cover most of it. Apps, YouTube and free guides cost nothing and will teach you vocabulary, script and listening.
- [Will Hindi speakers mind if I make mistakes?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/do-hindi-speakers-mind-mistakes/): Almost universally no — the reaction to a foreigner attempting Hindi is warmth, not correction.
- [Do I need to learn the Devanagari script to speak…](https://ekguru.shop/ask/do-i-need-to-learn-devanagari/): Strictly no — you can learn to speak using romanised Hindi. But it is a false economy: Devanagari takes about two weeks.
- [How many letters are in the Hindi alphabet?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/hindi-alphabet-question/): Hindi has 11 vowels and 33 consonants — 44 core letters. Counts of 46, 48 or 52 appear because some lists include extra vowels.
- [Why does Hindi have so many words for uncle?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/hindi-family-question/): Because the relationship itself is part of the word. चाचा is your father
- [How can I teach my child Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/hindi-for-kids-how-to-start/): Speak it at home from the start if you can, use songs and cartoons rather than lessons before about age seven.
- [Are Hindi and Urdu the same language?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/hindi-or-urdu-question/): In speech, largely yes — a Hindi speaker and an Urdu speaker understand each other completely.
- [Should I learn Hindi or Urdu?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/hindi-or-urdu-which-to-learn/): Spoken, they are close enough that learning one gives you most of the other.
- [What are the most useful Hindi words for a beginner?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/hindi-words-every-beginner-should-know/): About twenty words carry most everyday conversation: हाँ (yes), नहीं (no), क्या (what), कहाँ (where), कितना (how much), पानी (water), खाना (food).
- [How long does it take to learn Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-long-to-learn-hindi/): Around 4–6 months of consistent study for simple conversation, and 1–2 years for comfortable everyday fluency.
- [How long does it take to learn to read Devanagari?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-long-to-read-hindi-script/): Most learners read simple words within four to six weeks of regular practice, and read fluently — without sounding out — in about six months.
- [How many Hindi words do I need to know?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-many-words-do-i-need-in-hindi/): About 500 words for everyday survival, 1,500 for comfortable conversation, and around 3,000 to follow a film without subtitles.
- [How much does a Hindi tutor cost?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-much-does-a-hindi-tutor-cost/): Published EkGuru profiles currently list a tutor-stated price, from $6. Confirm the figure on the profile before booking.
- [How do you count from 1 to 10 in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-to-count-1-to-10-in-hindi/): एक ek (1), दो do (2), तीन teen (3), चार chaar (4), पाँच paanch (5), छह chhah (6), सात saat (7), आठ aath (8), नौ nau (9), दस das (10).
- [How do you introduce yourself in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-to-introduce-yourself-in-hindi/): नमस्ते, मेरा नाम ___ है (namaste, mera naam ___ hai) — hello, my name is ___. Then मैं ___ से हूँ (main ___ se hoon) for where you are from.
- [How can I practise speaking Hindi if I have nobody…](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-to-practice-hindi-without-a-partner/): Speak aloud anyway — narrate what you are doing, record sixty seconds and listen back.
- [How do I remember whether a Hindi noun is masculine…](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-to-remember-hindi-genders/): Learn the gender with the noun, never separately. Endings are a rough guide: most nouns in आ are masculine, most in ई feminine, with real exceptions.
- [How do you say congratulations in Hindi?](https://ekguru.shop/ask/how-to-say-congratulations-in-hindi/): शुभकामनाएँ (shubhkaamanaaen) is the direct, all-purpose translation — "good wishes." बधाई (badhaii) is the more celebratory, colloquial form use
